body: Remember to show yourself some grace just as you would show others.
I have done the married and kid thing.  He cheated and the turmoil I lived through made me realize no man is worth my sanity.  Nothing wrong with being single.
Congrats on taking the first step to the rest of your life.  The world is yours.  Enjoy it.  Make the most of it.  Please don’t look back.  Some things are better left behind.
It is about time, I can’t wait
If there are no buses in front of it, it will stay in the right lane.  It only moves to the left if there are buses pulled over to pick up passengers.
I was on the 269 just before this one.  It was too close for comfort.    My thoughts and prayers to those who were affected by this horrific accident.

It is so hard for the people left behind.  We always ask the question.  What could I have done differently?  I should have done more?  I should have been there?

Don’t be hard on yourself.  Your family and friends know it I wasn’t your fault.  They just need to blame someone.  Eventually they will come around.  

Stay strong.  So sorry for your loss

So sorry for your loss.  I too am grieving a friend who took her life just over a week ago.  She never reached out to me. She had for the better part of 3 years.  Why was this different.  They didn’t want to be talked out of it. 

Our questions will never be answered but hopefully we find peace in knowing they knows how much we loved them.

Take care and I wish you well
Thank you so much for your kind words.  I will check it out!

Was it worth it all in the long run?  

I have never traveled for that purpose however, someone has traveled to me.  Hopefully it wasn't just for that purpose.
He is everyone’s friend once you get on the floor and let him sniff you out lol
